narrative.overview: A practical, native desktop workspace with quiet surfaces and clear working actions. The signature is the project handoff: terminal access, saved next step, associated notes and Git state together. Existing GNOME conventions are the visual authority.
keyCharacteristics: Compact project rows with generous separation between working sections.
Existing cairn logo and project identity assets.

rules.name: The System Authority Rule
rules.body: Preserve native theme and accent behavior; never copy screenshot colors into a fixed application palette.

dos: Do use theme-owned colors, fonts and interaction states.
Do keep terminal access, next step, Git and notes easy to find.
Do reuse existing user project colors, shapes and the cairn logo.
donts: Don't treat browser preview CSS as production tokens.
Don't hard-code a GNOME accent or screenshot-specific font size.
Don't embed a replacement note editor in the suite.
